title: pipeline double-code: Response::new(441, "441 Duplicate...") puts code in text field
description: In post/pipeline.rs, Response::new(441, "441 Duplicate article: Message-ID already known") embeds the numeric code in the text argument. Response::to_bytes() prepends the code automatically, producing wire line '441 441 Duplicate article: Message-ID already known\r\n', which is malformed NNTP. Same pattern on the 500 internal error response. Any RFC 3977-conforming client will misbehave parsing or logging these double-code lines.
